sources.snippet: OpenBind releases its first predictive AI model OpenBind has released its first open predictive AI model, trained on high-quality experimental protein–ligand data. Released alongside the project’s first public dataset, it provides a foundation for predicting molecular interactions and benchmarking structure-based AI methods for drug discovery.
